217: Rabbi Chiya said, "When the letters were engraved on the tablets, they could be seen on both sides, from this side and from that side; and the tablets were made out of sapphire. So they were carved and covered with white fire, but the letters were from black fire, and they were carved from both sides, from this side and from that side."

Rabbi Abba said, "The tablets were solid, but the letters would fly and appear with two [types of] fire, a white fire and a black fire, so that they could be seen together, right and left. This is, as it is written (Proverbs 3:16), 'In her right hand is length of days, and in her left hand, etc.' But behold, it is [also] written, 'from His right hand went a fiery law for them!' Rather, it was from the side of power, and was included in the right. And that is why it is white fire and black fire."
